caption: The drawing consists of several outlined shapes arranged on a plain, light-colored background, all contained within a single-ruled rectangular border. The objects are labeled with small handwritten identifiers such as "A-1," "B-1," "A-2," and similar, with some numbers in parentheses. The shapes are all drawn with thin, precise black lines. The largest objects in the drawing resemble the front and back panels of a garment, each featuring curved edges, indentations, notches, and darts; two of the largest forms have lines indicating sleeve holes and side shaping. There are smaller, similarly outlined objects placed above and below the central large pieces, many of which are rectangular or irregularly polygonal in form, some with short, straight line markings or notches along their edges. Two long, parallel horizontal lines are drawn beside one of the large shapes on the right-hand side. The background is off-white or light beige, and there is no shading or color fill in any object; all elements are composed solely of the thin black outline.
title: Suit Pattern
